prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful (+3.5% after noise correction across 2 winning tests).
adoption, redesign changes did not work, showing negative or no clear effect (-5.2% after noise correction across 2 tests).
Predictions were inaccurate overall, overestimating early changes but underestimating some round 2 wins.
Evidence is still thin for finish, new_flow changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path changes (only 1 test each for reorder and copy).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in changes (only 1 test each for notification and hint).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Walkthrough Flow: Adds an interactive guided walkthrough screen after onboarding intro to teach users how to hide, show, and interact with their desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drops 21.4% with median 395s.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Stage Path Selection Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a visual stage layout with emphasis cards comparing custom creation vs ready adoption. (why: Choose path step drops 23.8% of users with high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation during path selection.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Sign In Placement: Moves account sign-in after pet adoption selection so users build emotional connection before creating an account. (why: Sign in currently sits right after path choice, causing drop-off (72.9% conversion) before users pick or see their pet.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidelines Hint: Shows a helpful hint on photo upload requirements to reduce custom generation glitches. (why: 3 support emails cited failed or distorted custom pet generation, and adoption drop-off is highest at 60.9% conversion.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Dual Column Path Comparison Layout: Presents path options in a structured side-by-side two column comparison layout. (why: Choose path mean duration is long (514s), showing users struggle to compare the two onboarding options.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split View Certificate Summary Confirmation: Uses a split view layout for the adoption certificate to clearly show pet summary details before finalizing. (why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean completion time (1017s).)

scores.note: Strong evidence from support emails and historical new_flow gains (+10.9%), but requires a new walkthrough screen.
Redesign changes historically underperformed (-5.2%) and lack support email validation.
Reordering sign-in reduces early friction, consistent with modest reorder test improvements (+0.8%).
Targets highest drop-off step (adoption, 60.9%) with direct support email evidence and low implementation cost.
Addresses long decision time on path selection, but evidence is weak without support email backing.
Focuses on the funnel's biggest bottleneck step (adoption) with a structural clarity update.
